tei:div.tei:p: chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: dregs pa rnam gsum gsol bskul bsdus pa phrin las dngos grub kun 'byung bzhugs: 528)na mo pad+ma kro dha ye: rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa yis: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gyi: gsol mchod bsdus pa brtson pa'i thabs: gtor ma skyes bcas bshams nas kyang: nam mkha' mdzod kyis byin gyis brlabs: rang nyid lha yi ting 'dzin ngang: hūm̐ bh+yo: ma skyes dag pa dbyings kyi zhing khams nas: ma mo yongs kyi rje mo dpal ldan ma: drag mo ral gcig e ka dzā ṭi ma: ma tshogs mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum dang bcas: 'khor bcas thogs med gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: khyad par thugs mthun phyi nang mchod pa dang: dam nyams dgra bo'i dbang po rnam lnga'i gsur: gser skyems phud dang dmar chen gtor ma 529) sogs: dpal ldan sngags srung 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: thugs dam dgyes skong ma g.yel sdong grogs mdzod: rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung ba'i mthu stobs can: dam ldan rnal 'byor grogs byed dam nyams sgrol: gza' bdud dug gi spu gri 'khor dang bcas: 'dir gshegs phyi nang mchod pa dpag med dang: ra rog dbang po lnga dang dam nyams dgra'i: sha khrag la sogs snying sna sha sna'i rigs: gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la: 'bul lo thugs dam gnyen po bskang nas kyang: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i las rnams kun 'grub mdzod: dam can chen po rdo rje legs pa rtsal: mched 'khor ma lus 530)gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dmar chen gtor ma khrag chen skyems phud dang: dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag sna tshogs 'bul: thugs dam bskang la phyi nang bar chad sol: rnal 'byor phrin las rab 'byams myur 'grub mdzod: bh+yo ma ma rak+mo bh+yo e ka dzā ṭi hriṃ dzaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: oṃ rak+sha rā hu la i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: oṃ badz+ra sā dhu tri shu la i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: lan gsum gyis 'bul: phrin las bcol ba ni:

hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dbyings kyi rje mo e ka dzā: gza' bdud dug gi spu gri che: dam can chen po rdo rje legs: dregs pa rnam gsum 'khor dang bcas: rnal 'byor phrin las bcol ba ni: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang: rdo rje slob dpon sku dgra dang: rnal 'byor bdag gi sgos dgra sogs: ma rung bstan la 'tshe byed pa'i: log 'dren thams cad rdul du rlog: sha khrag rus gsum rngams zas gyis: khyad par bdag la sdang byed pa'i: dam nyams gdug can thams kyis: gsang sngags chos la skur pa btab: gsang 'dzin rnal 'byor sku la bsdos: sma phab brnyas byed snying gnag pa: bstan pa smad cing brku 'phrog brtsams: mthu nus snyogs shing bstan la 'tshe: 531)dam nyams sgral ba'i zhing du gyur: do nub nam gung tshun chod la: srog snying dmar po khyer la shog: sha khrag longs spyod tshe bsod nams: bka' srung rnams kyis za ngu gyis: rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drongs: rjes shul lhag ma med par mdzod: mdor na rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: bsam pa sgrub la re ba skongs: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: ci bcol las rnams 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo ma mo rak+mo bh+yo: e ka dzā ṭi hriṃ dzaḥ oṃ rak+sha rā hu la hūm̐ dzaḥ badz+ra sā dhu tri shu la sa ma ya dzaḥ dgra bo mā ra ya bh+yo bzlog sa ma ya rbad nan bh+yo: zhes brjod gtor skyems dgra bo'i phyogs su mchod: rgyun du 'di la brtson gyur na: bka' srung lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs: phrin las gang bcol 'grub par nges: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ḍāk+ki'i rgya: zhes dregs pa rnam gsum gyi gsol bskul bsdus pa 'di'ang nyams snang la bka' srung rnam gsum gyi brdas yang yang bskul ma byung ba la brten nas kho mo bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// dge'o// 532)
